set.body:
Turn fit results into a durable, resumable boundary that group analysis can consume independently of the first-level process.

Scope:
- Define a typed block sink protocol with begin, write block, finalize, and abort semantics; only finalized manifests are discoverable.
- Build a FirstLevelCatalog containing stable unit, contrast, statistic, geometry, provenance, physical artifact, and completion identities.
- Compose the existing ResultManifest and JVM result writers rather than duplicating statistic or format models.
- Preserve the compatibility bundled NIfTI layout and the opt-in one-named-map-per-NIfTI BIDS-like layout, including exact manifest entries and filename collision checks.
- Make format selection a pluggable JVM capability. BIDS/NIfTI is the required reference adapter; HDF5, GDS, Zarr, or remote stores are optional follow-ons.

Acceptance:
- Spatial blocks can be written incrementally and finalized atomically into a complete first-level catalog.
- Retry of an already committed work ID is idempotent; failed or interrupted writes do not appear complete.
- Both NIfTI layouts round-trip map identity, space, contrast or coefficient name, statistic kind, and provenance.
- Group input can reopen the finalized catalog in a fresh process without fit objects in memory.
set.title: Workflow output: add transactional result sinks and a durable first-level catalog
